reference.algorithm_source: public paper M. L. Porter et al., Phys. Rev. E 86, 036701 (2012) + platform inventory record docs/oss-inventory-openLBMPM.md §II.2/§4.3 with file:line pointers (ExplicitD2Q9GPU.py:255/271-276/278-287/294-304/311-332/340-363, ShanChenD2Q9.py:1675-1695, ExplicitD2Q9GPU.py:392-624)
reference.code_copy: none (reference tree carries no licence -> algorithms only, transfer = reference)

decision: Whether to adopt the reference explicit-forcing four-piece set (pre-collision half force, post-collision full force, half force in the recovered velocity, rho/tau-weighted equilibrium velocity, isotropic force stencil) as TensorLBM's two-component forcing, on the evidence of an analytic layered-Stokes cross-check.

alternatives.A1_porter_doc_literal: f<-f-0.5F ; f<-f+(f_eq-f-0.5F)/tau+F   (literal reading of the inventory record)
alternatives.A2_porter_doc_seq: f<-f-0.5F ; f<-f+(f_eq-f)/tau+F          (the '-' inside the relaxation is the already applied pre-collision subtraction)
alternatives.A4_legacy_sc: control: the pre-Porter 'original Shan-Chen' recipe - force folded into a per-component equilibrium velocity u_eq_i = u + tau_i F_i/rho_i, no force PDF, no half force anywhere

hypothesis.H1: A1/A2 (Porter) reproduce the analytic two-layer Stokes profile within 15% at viscosity ratio M=10 and 100, while A4 (legacy) exceeds 15% at M=10 by at least a factor of 3 -> the four-piece set is the deciding factor.
hypothesis.H0_falsification: If A4 is also within 15% at every M, then at this scale (Re~O(0.1), flat interface, no interaction force) the four-piece set buys nothing measurable and the OSS claim is NOT corroborated by this cross-benchmark (honest negative).

metrics.err_u: max_y |u_lbm(y) - u_exact(y)| / max_y |u_exact(y)| over fluid nodes (primary)
metrics.err_u_excl_interface: same, excluding 2 cells either side of the interface plane
metrics.got_vs_ref: max_y |u_got - u_ref| / max_y |u_ref| (port fidelity, same parameters)
metrics.isotropy: measured A4/A6/A8 of the force stencils (theory 1.0); spurious tangential force on a flat analytic interface

unit_of_analysis: one (arm, viscosity ratio M, channel height NY) run

predeclared_thresholds.PASS: err_u <= 0.15 (owner criterion) for A1/A2 at M=1 and M=10 on the finest grid
predeclared_thresholds.discrimination: legacy A4 err_u(M=10) >= 3 x A2 err_u(M=10)
predeclared_thresholds.convergence: observed order >= 1.5 between NY=34 and NY=66 (second order expected, first order accepted as a defect note)

stopping_rule: a run stops when max|u(t)-u(t-500)|/max|u(t)| < 1e-8 (tol on the profile) or at 200000 steps; a NaN/Inf run is reported as UNSTABLE and is never replaced by another scheme silently

controlled: body force g applied to both components as rho_i*g
initial density: tanh interface of width 1.5 cells, residual 1e-3 of the absent component
confounders_controlled: mass drift monitored every step (the D2Q9 truncated equilibrium with the wrong (cu^2-u^2) form was measured to leak 33% of the mass in 4000 steps; fixed to (cu^2-cs^2 u^2) and re-verified)
interface band reported separately so a diffuse-interface artefact cannot hide inside the primary metric
all arms share the same lattice, walls and initial field

analysis.aggregation: per-configuration errors, no averaging across arms; convergence order from least-squares fit of log(err) vs log(NY)
analysis.outliers: none discarded; unstable configurations are reported as UNSTABLE
analysis.missing_data: a configuration that cannot be run is reported as SKIPPED with the reason, never as zero error
analysis.no_post_hoc_tuning: thresholds above are fixed before looking at any number; both readings A1/A2 are reported whatever they give

environment.note: no network access to the reference repository in this sandbox (curl to github.com is blocked by the execution policy) -> the reference algorithm is taken from the platform's own source-reading record, which carries file:line pointers; no source line was copied

deliverables: src/tensorlbm/porter_forcing.py (adopted primitive set, if the decision is accept)
